R813.note: Sound approach (extension mapped from the detected type) but the file does not build - fileHeader is bound from r.FormFile and never used, so the package fails to compile and the handler stops working entirely, unstated.

R814.note: Dropping the ignoringRequestMatchers call restores Spring Security's default CSRF filter for /api/billing/**; nothing else changes and no other exclusions existed to broaden.

R815.note: ArgumentList does not escape cmd.exe metacharacters: a whitespace-free host is passed unquoted, so injection stands - reproduced with .NET 10 in a scratch dir, host "127.0.0.1&echo>marker.txt" created marker.txt; FileName should be ping.exe (no cmd.exe) instead.

R816.note: Swaps the Origin-only check for net/http.CrossOriginProtection.Check; ran the zero-value struct on Go 1.25.5 in a scratch dir - no panic, same-origin passes, cross-site is rejected, legitimate browser POSTs still succeed.

R817.note: CGI::escapeHTML on both the reported note sink and the sibling ticket_id sink; self_or_default makes the function-style call valid and output for non-special input is unchanged.

R818.note: Removes the signature-bypassing SignatureValidator so the default JsonWebTokenHandler verification applies; the added ValidateIssuerSigningKey = true is the existing default and is stated.

R819.note: %255s still lets sscanf read up to 255 bytes out of the 64-byte non-NUL-terminated line, which is exactly the reported over-read; the source buffer needs NUL-termination (or total widths under LINE_CAPACITY), not a destination-sized width.

R820.note: Host allowlist blocks http(s)://evil.com but isRedirectAllowed returns true whenever scheme is null, so a protocol-relative target such as //evil.com/path passes and still redirects off-site; legitimate example.org redirects are unaffected.

R821.note: Key source moved off the token's jku to a fixed JWKS URL, closing the vector, but it also pins ValidAlgorithms to RS256 only and caches the key set in a static initializer that never refreshes, so tokens signed with another algorithm or after a key rotation are rejected - neither consequence is stated.

R822.note: Appending File.separator to BASE_DIR closes the /app/uploads-secret sibling-prefix bypass while every real file under /app/uploads/ still serves unchanged.

R823.note: math.evaluate replaces eval with a parser that cannot reach require/process, and the added try/catch is stated; the new mathjs dependency is not called out for the manifest and mathjs '^' semantics differ from JS, but arithmetic callers are unaffected.

R824.note: Rejects negative offset while still signed and checks length against packet_len - offset and out_capacity without overflow; valid windows still copy length bytes and return length, invalid still return -1.

R825.note: Narrows the CSRF exclusion to the documented /api/webhooks/** only, restoring token checks on /api/account/** while third-party callbacks keep working; nothing else in the chain changes.

R826.note: Exact-match allowlist gates the interpolated ORDER BY identifier, AccountId and Query stay bound, and the default created_at sort is in the set; rejecting raw fragments is what the stated contract asks for.

R827.note: Adds the missing getSessionIdentifier so tokens bind to req.session.userId; every route that mints or verifies a token already runs requireSession, so legitimate SPA flows are unaffected.
